title: Team Sports Product Artwork Intern
note: Product artwork templates for footballs, basketballs, volleyballs and soccer balls; open to graphic, industrial and product design majors.

facts.duties: Rotate through four team sports; audit 2D-to-3D artwork templates and vendor communication; build new templates and a consistent sampling process; test UV-print decoration and automation tools.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's student in graphic, industrial or product design (or computer science); Adobe Creative Suite; Illustrator automation experience; available full-time for the summer.
facts.apply: Apply online on Wilson's iCIMS careers site, job 2026-5231.
